name: North Carolina Executive Mansion
scope: The permanent 2025 exterior of the North Carolina Executive Mansion in Raleigh, including its brick massing, steep slate gables, ornate western porches and loggias, turrets and mapped side wings.

originalReview.notes: The wide photograph shows the full symmetrical brick elevation with three steep gables, two upper loggias, central door porch, slate roofs and extended side verandas.

references.filename: Halloween 2025 at North Carolina Executive Mansion.jpg

originalReview.notes: The closer axial photograph shows the deep porch and cream gallery trim, canted window bays, slate colors and light marble entry; some upper fenestration is hidden by branches.

review.method: Two exact Qualla originals and named native public-domain dedication
review.notes: Two exact local Qualla originals match the original uploader and own-work CC0 dedications. The gate-only and dining room pictures are excluded from the exterior selection; the models use the permanent architecture visible behind seasonal decorations.
